mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen or bathroom remodeling project take?

text: Determining a precise construction schedule relies heavily on the physical size of your room, required structural changes, electrical and plumbing re-configurations, and material availability. A comprehensive kitchen overhaul involving custom cabinetry, stone countertop fabrication, tile backsplash installation, and fixture upgrades typically spans three to five weeks of active on-site labor once all materials have been delivered. Smaller kitchen updates or straight surface replacements can often be completed even faster when structural walls remain unchanged. Bathrooms follow a similar predictable cadence; a standard guest bath update usually finishes within seven to ten business days, whereas an extensive master suite bath renovation takes roughly two to three weeks. We focus on completing work efficiently without ever cutting corners on drying times, waterproofing cures, or code inspections.

To eliminate unexpected downtime during active construction, our team establishes a fully staged project plan long before the first demolition hammer hits your wall. We pre-order all custom cabinetry, specialty plumbing fixtures, quartz slabs, and imported tiles in advance, verifying that every single component sits safely in storage before tearing out existing fixtures. This deliberate staging approach prevents scenario where your home sits idle for weeks waiting on a backordered faucet or custom cabinet door. Every client receives a structured line-item schedule detailing specific trade visits, floor protection steps, framing days, tiling phases, and final inspections. Should unexpected hidden issues like historic wood rot or outdated wiring arise behind open walls, we communicate the necessary adjustments immediately alongside clear timeline updates.

mainEntity.name: What is GEA Construction's remodeling process?

text: Our operational methodology is structured around five deliberate phases engineered to eliminate confusion, manage costs, and deliver superior building quality. It starts with an initial on-site consultation where we evaluate your existing physical space, listen to your functional goals, take precise field measurements, and discuss visual style preferences. Next, we translate those details into a comprehensive, fully itemized scope of work complete with fixed line-item pricing so you understand exact material and labor costs up front. Once the proposal receives your sign-off, phase three focuses on administrative preparation, where we submit all detailed construction drawings, material finish samples, and site plans to local municipal building departments and neighborhood architectural review boards. Securing official approvals before pulling trade permits ensures full compliance and protects your investment.

The fourth phase brings active construction, beginning with floor protection laydowns, zip-wall dust containment, and controlled structural demolition. Throughout the build phase, our project managers coordinate skilled trade technicians, execute structural modifications, install specialized finishes, and manage mandatory municipal rough-in inspections. We maintain active daily communication with you, offering visual photo updates and answering questions as work progresses toward completion. The fifth and final phase involves a thorough quality assurance walkthrough alongside the homeowner to inspect every tile grout line, cabinet hinge, paint edge, and electrical switch. Any minor touch-ups are recorded on a formal punch list and resolved immediately before final payment, ensuring total satisfaction with your newly transformed space.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle local municipal permits and HOA/ARB approvals?

text: Navigating government building departments and neighborhood HOA regulations can easily feel overwhelming for homeowners attempting to manage renovations independently. GEA Construction assumes complete responsibility for every administrative requirement, pulling official building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits with local authorities across Beaufort and Jasper counties. Our thorough familiarity with South Carolina building codes guarantees that every beam modification, window replacement, deck structure, or shower plumbing shift satisfies modern structural standards. We schedule all mandatory municipal inspections at key construction milestones, meeting on-site directly with code enforcement officials to secure formal sign-offs. This rigorous approach ensures your home remains fully compliant, legally protected, and easy to insure or sell in the future.

In addition to city and county permits, we possess extensive experience handling strict Architectural Review Board (ARB) submittals for master-planned coastal communities. Gated Lowcountry plantations maintain rigid guidelines regarding exterior paint swatches, rooflines, window styles, deck materials, tree preservation zones, and hardscape setbacks. Our office compiles complete application packets containing architectural elevation drawings, manufacturer material cut sheets, physical trim samples, site surveys, and landscape impact plans required by your specific board. We represent your project directly during review meetings, responding to board inquiries and making necessary plan tweaks promptly to secure swift written approvals. By managing these complex bureaucratic workflows entirely in-house, we save you significant time and protect your project from costly community violation fines.

mainEntity.name: What materials do you use for decks and outdoor living projects?

text: Outdoor structures built in the humid coastal Lowcountry must withstand intense ultraviolet heat, relentless rain showers, destructive termites, and salty air currents. GEA Construction constructs high-performance composite decks using industry-leading capped composite and PVC decking materials from brands like Trex and TimberTech. These advanced synthetic surface boards resist splintering, fading, staining, and rotting, completely removing the grueling annual task of sanding and staining natural wood boards. We install boards utilizing hidden clipping systems that secure decking from the sides, creating a sleek, barefoot-friendly surface completely free of exposed screw heads. To frame these beautiful outdoor spaces, we incorporate custom aluminum or powder-coated cable railing systems that maximize surrounding views of local marshes, lagoons, and golf courses.

The invisible subframe beneath your deck boards determines whether the structure lasts five years or thirty years, which is why we over-engineer our framing foundations. We construct support framing using heavy-duty pressure-treated lumber specifically rated for ground contact, securing post connections into deep concrete footings. Crucially, we protect every joist top and beam surface with waterproof butyl joist tape, creating a protective membrane that prevents standing water from seeping into wood grain and causing subframe rot. All frame connections, structural hangers, and carriage bolts utilize marine-grade stainless steel or double-dipped galvanized hardware built to resist coastal corrosion. Whether constructing a custom multi-level composite deck or a screened porch with under-deck drainage, our structural techniques yield long-lasting performance.

mainEntity.name: Are your replacement windows and doors rated for coastal storms?

text: Upgrading exterior doors and windows along the South Carolina coast demands strict structural attention to wind-borne debris hazards and intense atmospheric pressure changes. GEA Construction exclusively installs high-efficiency, impact-rated windows and entry door systems specifically engineered to meet or exceed rigorous coastal building codes. These advanced window units feature heavy-duty laminated safety glass sandwiching a clear structural interlayer that remains intact even if impacted by flying storm debris. Beyond hurricane defense, impact glass delivers outstanding daily benefits by blocking over 99 percent of harmful ultraviolet rays that fade interior hardwood floors and furniture. Furthermore, the thick multi-pane laminated construction dramatically reduces exterior noise pollution from neighborhood traffic, lawn mowers, and storms, creating a noticeably quieter indoor living sanctuary.

Proper installation techniques matter just as much as purchasing a high-quality glass unit when protecting your home against severe coastal weather. Our technicians frame, level, flash, and seal every opening using multi-layer self-adhering flashing tapes, high-grade silicones, and non-expanding closed-cell foam insulation. This meticulous installation seals out driving rain and eliminates drafty air leaks, directly reducing your monthly heating and air conditioning power bills. We offer extensive style options ranging from classic double-hung windows with traditional lowcountry divider grilles to expansive multi-panel sliding patio doors that seamlessly open living spaces to covered porches. Upgrading your home's thermal envelope with certified impact-rated glass not only elevates visual curb appeal, but also frequently qualifies homeowners for substantial savings on annual coastal windstorm insurance premiums.

mainEntity.name: How do you waterproof custom tile showers during bath remodels?

text: Preventing moisture penetration behind shower walls is the absolute most critical technical aspect of any high-end bathroom renovation project. Traditional shower construction methods rely on outdated liquid painted membranes or simple mortar beds with weep holes that frequently fail, trapping moisture and causing structural wood rot or hidden mold growth over time. GEA Construction completely eliminates water intrusion risks by installing fully integrated Schluter-KERDI waterproofing systems beneath every tile installation. We construct shower walls using rigid, waterproof KERDI-BOARD panels, fastening them securely to wall studs with specialized target washers and structural screws. This forms a continuous, completely sealed, vapor-tight enclosure that permanently prevents steam and water from ever reaching the underlying wooden studs.

Our technicians seal every panel seam, wall intersection, shower niche corner, and fastener head using KERDI-BAND waterproofing strips embedded in specialized modified thin-set mortar. We install prefabricated, pre-sloped shower trays combined with integrated bonding drain flanges, ensuring wastewater flows directly down the drain without pooling beneath floor tiles. Pipe protrusions and mixing valves receive engineered elastic pipe seals to guarantee no water sneaks behind wall valves during daily shower use. Prior to laying a single decorative tile, we conduct thorough flood tests by capping the drain and filling the basin to verify a 100% watertight seal. When your custom tile, natural stone, or linear drain is set over our sealed substrate, you receive a luxurious, low-maintenance shower engineered to last for decades.

mainEntity.name: How is a custom paver patio built to prevent sagging and standing water?

text: A stunning outdoor paver patio or natural travertine terrace is only as stable as the invisible structural foundation constructed underneath its surface. Installing pavers directly over soft coastal sand or poor topsoil inevitable results in uneven shifting, sunken tire tracks, weeds taking root, and pooling water during rainstorms. GEA Construction begins hardscape projects by excavating native soil down to a firm, sub-grade depth determined by specific site conditions. We lay down thick layers of crushed granite aggregate base rock, saturating and compacting the base materials in heavy layers using mechanical plate compactors. This dense sub-base forms a rigid, load-bearing platform that prevents future soil settling and handles severe vehicle or patio furniture weight without cracking or dipping.

Over the compacted aggregate base, we spread a smooth, level layer of washed concrete bedding sand engineered for proper water drainage. Pavers or natural stone tiles are laid in carefully planned architectural patterns, utilizing string lines and laser levels to establish subtle slope angles away from your home's foundation. Heavy-duty plastic edge restraints secured with long steel spikes are fastened around the entire perimeter to lock pavers in place and prevent lateral spreading. Once the surface is set, we sweep specialized polymeric sand into every joint line, activating the binder with a light water mist to lock pavers together. This hardened joint sand forms a durable barrier that stops weed growth, prevents ant infestations, and allows rainwater to drain cleanly off your patio.

mainEntity.name: How much does a home remodeling project cost?

text: Project costs vary across residential construction projects depending on square footage, structural layout changes, plumbing and electrical modifications, and specific material selections. A simple cosmetic refresh using builder-grade materials costs significantly less than a full structural renovation featuring high-end custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and imported tile. Because every house in the Lowcountry presents unique architectural footprints and site conditions, providing generic flat rates without inspecting the property can lead to inaccurate budgeting. We prioritize complete financial transparency, evaluating your exact physical space and design goals during an initial on-site consultation. This thorough review allows us to construct an accurate financial framework tailored specifically to your expectations without hidden surprises down the road.

Following our initial site evaluation, GEA Construction provides a detailed, fully itemized written proposal detailing exact labor, material, permit, and trade management costs line by line. You receive clear pricing breakdowns for every phase of construction, allowing you to adjust material choices or project scope to fit comfortably within your target budget. We discuss various material tiers with you—such as comparing capped composite decking against natural hardwoods or custom tiled showers against prefabricated units—so you can make informed investment choices. Our transparent pricing model guarantees that the figure listed on your signed agreement remains the fixed cost of your project unless you request formal changes. Contact our office today to schedule your consultation and receive a precise estimate for your upcoming home renovation.
